title: Lanterns for the Long Stair
story: Salgrave the Stair Shade lives in the darkness of a 1,000-foot spiral crypt stair and grows stronger wherever light fails. Each hollow-glass lantern lights 45 feet of stair, and Mr 6 must light the whole thing to lead a lost choir of village children back up. Half-lit stairs don't count — Salgrave slips through gaps.
question: How many lanterns does Mr 6 need to light all 1,000 feet of stair if each lantern lights 45 feet?
hint: Divide 1,000 by 45 — then think hard about the leftover stretch of stair.
victory: The twenty-third lantern covered the last stubborn 10 feet, and Salgrave, with nowhere dark left to stand, politely became a shadow puppet for the children instead.
imagePrompt: A tall spiral stone staircase in a crypt lined with warm glowing lanterns, a thin shadow creature shrinking into the last dark corner, a caped numeral six leading a line of children upward.
